# Audio fixture

`tone-440hz.mp3` is an original two-second 440 Hz sine wave, generated by
`scripts/generate-fixture.py` at 44.1 kHz, mono, 128 kbit/s MP3. It contains
no third-party recording, music composition or personal audio.

The project contributors dedicate the generated audio to the public domain
under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
The generator is project code, subject to the project's Apache-2.0 license.
libmp3lame is needed only to regenerate it; the server never transcodes files.
